notes.title: Job Joust is out!
notes.content:
Job Joust is out!

Dunk and bump your friends in this 6-player physics-based party game with wacky characters. Become a levitating doctor or an exploding policeman with cumulative perks and show your friends who has the best job!

Here’s what’s available in this full version:


 6-Player Party Game 
 40+ Maps 
 65+ Unique Powers 
 8 Characters
 Team-Based Combat Mode
 Steam Remote Play Together integration

Feel free to give us any feedback about the game! And if you liked it, consider leaving a review. :)

Job Joust will be available with a 20% discount for 7 days.

Thanks again for your support, and stay tuned for our next projects!

[previewyoutube=7W3gwHp_5TM;full][/previewyoutube]

Mad Mango Games

notes.title: Job Joust - Steam Next Fest - Live Stream
notes.content:
Welcome to Job Joust!

Dunk and bump your friends in this 4-Players physics party game with wacky characters. Become a levitating Doctor or an exploding policeman with cumulative perks and show your friends what’s the best job!

Job Joust is a physics-based party game where you bump and dunk your friends as a wacky employee. Up to 4 players can fight in this fast-paced local multiplayer mayhem.

Choose equipments to improve from round to round and make the best comebacks! From the giant stealthy C.E.O. to the levitating exploding Policeman, you can become your ultimate self! Combine power-ups together for incredible (or stupid) synergies!

Made to be easily played by anyone, it is the perfect tool to settle your couple fights or family conflicts. But hardcore players will find a great depth in mastering bounce angles, reads and spikes to demolish their friends in the most satisfying ways.

Avoid bumpers, push your victims on lasers and use teleporters to your advantage! Hazard plays an important role in your success!

Don't forget to wishlist the game! That'll help us a lot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800510/Job_Joust/

Feel free to join our discord here : https://discord.gg/FQyD7u6Xvv

Thank you!

notes.title: Massive Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

We've been working hard on the game for the past few months and we wanted to let you play the most up-to-date version with this new Demo Update!

What to expect?
 - 27 Maps! We revamped them all and added a LOT of variety!
 - New Elements! Water, Cannons, Grenades, Mines, Spikes... The environment has many new ways to hurt you!
 - Revamped items! Find better, more diverse items to make the best builds!
 - A total Combat overhaul! The feel is now more responsive, juicier, funnier!
 - 2 New Characters! Play as the Boxer or the Broke Artist!
 - Better AI! Our bots are more challenging than ever!
 - And more...

We'd love to get your feedback on this new, amazing version of Job Joust!

Don't forget to wishlist the game to be among the first to play at release and discover all the cool features we have for you! :D

notes.title: Job Joust V0.1.1 is out!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We noticed a few bugs in the demo and some minor issue that we wanted to fix to get the best experience.
Since those fix are quite small, we've also included a new map with a new mechanic :)

Here is the patchnote :
- 1 new map !
- Only host player can now input in Steam Remote Player invite
- Changed policeman color for better clarity
- Improvements on 32:9 resolution screens
- Add a better game icon
- Other minor fixes

Thanks for your support!
